title: Bangkok and Thailand Flood Risk Data 2011-2026
description:
Flood data for Bangkok and Thailand compiled and cleaned by ThaiFloodRisk.com from official Thai sources (Bangkok Metropolitan Administration, GISTDA) and open datasets, as CSV files: every standing-water episode recorded by the BMA on Bangkok's main roads from October 2021 to October 2026 (1,762 episodes) with totals by district and the most flooded roads; the share of each Bangkok district and sub-district mapped under water in 2011; flood risk indicators for 189 rail stations and 85 districts, cities and destinations; and the share of days with flooded roads by forecast rain.

Latest version and interactive maps: https://thaifloodrisk.com/en/open-data. Methodology: https://thaifloodrisk.com/en/methodology.
